text.en:
IQF Frozen Figs

Tufan Organik IQF Frozen Figs belongs to the Frozen Fruits range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

تين مجمد فردياً (IQF)

IQF-tiefgefrorene Feigen
